address_convention.note: Addresses are Ghidra segmented addresses. Ghidra loads the image at segment 0x1000, so the real DOS segment is SEG-0x1000.
address_convention.file_off_ghidra: Memory.getAddressSourceInfo().getFileOffset(), independent of the formula; the two must agree.

classification_rule.rule: game iff the function's Ghidra segment == 0x1000 (real DOS segment 0x0000, the program's own code segment); rtl otherwise.
classification_rule.basis: Borland Pascal emits the main program body into its own code segment and each linked unit (System, Crt, Dos, Overlay) into further segments. Ghidra's MZ loader gives each a separate block.
classification_rule.rerun: Every function record carries seg, real_seg, caller_count and calls_segment_1000, so a different rule can be applied to this file without re-running Ghidra. No branch is dropped by classification.

limits.caveat: This is a LOWER BOUND. Branches inside bytes Ghidra did not disassemble are absent and cannot be counted from here.

port_cross_reference.metric: port_touched is true iff the branch's own address or its guard's address appears as a SEG:OFF citation in src/**/*.rs or data/command_dispatch.json. docs/re/*.md is deliberately NOT scanned: documented is not ported.
port_cross_reference.means: port_touched == false means 'no address citation', NOT 'unimplemented'. uncited_spans is a ranking of where the port's own notes stop; it is not a to-do list.

observed_failure_directions.detail: src/game.rs cites both addresses precisely in order to record that the port does NOT spend those two Random draws. A citation can be a record of a gap.

Shop prices were ported from the extracted table in data/shops.json rather than read branch by branch, so shop menu bodies carry no branch citations and read as untouched even though part of their behaviour is modelled.
